record.paper_title: Selected Open Problems in Discrete Geometry and Optimization
record.original_question: Let C(n) be the maximum number of touching pairs in a packing of n unit balls in Euclidean 3-space. Does the limit as n tends to infinity of (6n - C(n)) / n^(2/3) exist?

evidence.quote: If P is a packing of n unit balls in E3, then let C(P) stand for the number of touching pairs in P, that is, let C(P) denote the number of edges of the contact graph of P and call it the contact number of P. Moreover, let C(n) be the largest C(P) for packings P of n unit balls in E3.
Problem 2. Does the limit lim n to infinity (6n - C(n)) / n2/3 exist?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a packing $P$ of $n$ unit balls in Euclidean 3-space $\mathbb{E}^3$ (a finite family of closed unit balls with pairwise disjoint interiors), let $C(P)$ denote the number of touching pairs in $P$, i.e., the number of edges of the contact graph of $P$ (whose vertices are the centers of the balls, with two vertices adjacent iff the corresponding balls touch). Define
$$C(n) = \max\{C(P) : P \text{ is a packing of } n \text{ unit balls in } \mathbb{E}^3\}.$$
Determine whether the limit
$$\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{6n - C(n)}{n^{2/3}}$$
exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Known bounds give $0.695 < (6n - C(n))/n^{2/3} < \sqrt[3]{486} \approx 7.862$ for certain $n$, and $6n - C(n) > 0.926\,n^{2/3}$ for all packings, but the existence of the limit as $n\to\infty$ does not appear to have been established. Recent works by Bezdek and collaborators on contact numbers continue to refine such bounds without resolving the existence of the limit.

status_evidence.title: Contact Numbers for Congruent Sphere Packings in Euclidean 3-Space
status_evidence.claim: Quantitative bounds on (6n - C(n))/n^{2/3} are established, but existence of the limit is left open.

status_evidence.title: Contact graphs of unit sphere packings revisited
status_evidence.snippet: Improvements on contact-number estimates for congruent ball packings in E^3.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work refines bounds but does not establish the limit.

status_evidence.title: On contact numbers of locally separable unit sphere packings
status_evidence.snippet: Further developments on contact numbers in restricted settings.
status_evidence.claim: Recent contributions do not resolve the general limit question.
